description: Synthetic: Codex's `codex login --device-auth` screen, a sign-in link, a one-time code, and a last line 'Enter code ABCD-12345'. That line is typed in the browser: the CLI shows no › composer, so nothing on the pane takes a reply. A text question is dropped and the pane is an external wait (tests/test_classify.py proves the override); the link and code stay as links/copyables.
